name: Who's Watching
description: Click your avatar in Jellyfin Web to open a Netflix-style "Who's watching?" screen and switch profile. Optional "Remember on this device" (never for administrators; keeps Jellyfin's access token, never a password), Manage profiles with a shared picture gallery, brand text, and a settings page. Sign-in goes through Jellyfin's own login API, so all of Jellyfin's rules apply.
overview: Netflix-style profile switching from the avatar button in Jellyfin Web

versions.changelog: The picker now greets you on the sign-in page (first visit, after signing out), with Jellyfin's page one tap away for manual sign-in, Quick Connect and Forgot password, and the Login Disclaimer shown. It is styled by the active theme like Jellyfin's own pages: Jellyfin's buttons, fields, checkbox and card colours, no rounding unless the theme rounds, and the page's own background. Switching works where Jellyfin's Remember me was unticked. TV layout: no file picker, clearer focus. Each person may add up to 20 gallery pictures, and only whole JPEGs.

The picker scales with the screen: the same proportions from phones and 1080p up to 1440p and 4K, limited by height on wide or short windows (the brand-text size is now pixels at 1080p and scales too). Older engines keep the fixed 1080p sizes. Pressing the avatar starts loading the profiles, so the picker opens as the click lands.

Works on older browsers and apps: Jellyfin Media Player's Chromium, Safari before 15.4, older WebViews and webOS (fallbacks for dialog, replaceChildren, createImageBitmap, :focus-visible, flexbox gap, aspect-ratio, clamp/max/env). Console notes explain when the avatar is left alone.
